title: Account linking on the IdP subject, never the email string
description: THE CLASSIC ACCOUNT TAKEOVER: link on an email address and an attacker registers the victim's address at a second IdP and walks in. So link on the IdP's subject identifier -- Google's `sub`, GitHub's numeric user id -- and never on the email. Require email_verified from Google; for GitHub read /user/emails and accept only verified: true. Email is a display hint at first link, confirmed explicitly, and never the join key. A test shows a second IdP presenting the same email does not reach the first account.
